title: Automated artifact legal gating and pinned version workflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an end-to-end, automated gating workflow for model artifacts that enforces license compliance and flags artifacts with encumbrances before publishing performance profiles or allowing version pinning. The goal is to prevent models with incompatible licenses or unknown weight provenance from being listed in the public catalog or assigned a stable pinned version until cleared by legal/PM/ops. The flow should be resilient (automated classifier + checksum provenance + human review queue), integrate with the console and CI, and attach a clear clearance status to every artifact and model-version.
acceptance_criteria: New model artifact uploads run license classification and checksum provenance check automatically
Artifacts with clear permissive licenses receive a 'cleared' status and can be published and pinned by PMs
Artifacts flagged as 'potentially encumbered' or 'unknown provenance' are routed to a human review queue with prioritized triage
Publishing a performance profile to the public catalog is blocked until artifact status is 'cleared'
An audit trail (timestamped events, reviewer, decision, justification) is stored and queryable via Console
Integration tests in CI validate gating behavior for permissive, restrictive, and ambiguous license samples
proposed_flow: 1) On upload: extract license metadata, compute cryptographic checksums (SHA-256), and run a license classifier over declared licenses and text in manifests. 2) Check weights provenance: compare checksums against internal allowlist, known mirrors, and previous imports; run heuristics for architecture/size mismatches. 3) Compute a risk score (license compatibility, provenance confidence, thirdparty indicators). 4) Auto-clear if risk score below threshold and license is compatible; assign 'cleared' tag and allow publishing/pinning. 5) If risk score above threshold or license ambiguous, create a human-review ticket with prefilled context (diff to nearest known artifact, manifest, checksum evidence, sample license text). 6) Human reviewer (Legal/PM/RE) resolves: clear, require remediation (replace weights, add license), or quarantine. 7) Only cleared artifacts can be assigned a pinned-version and have performance profiles published in the public catalog. 8) All actions emit events to audit log and trigger UI updates in Console.
operational_notes: Risk threshold tunable via feature flag; initial threshold conservative to minimize false-clears
Classifier should support multi-license manifests and SPDX expressions
Reviewer UI must surface diff of model behavior if available (perf profile), not just license text
Add a lightweight 'escrow token' mechanism: store original checksum and author signature to support future provenance audits
Plan an initial whitelist for high-volume community models to reduce reviewer load
